identity_source.note: Exact-head strict Revision 9 validation, review-window contract and 64-entry materialization succeeded. Exact blobs cover libnimf request/reply framing, module/server/service lifecycle, GTK/Qt adapters, Anthy/Libhangul engines, settings/build inputs and the first m17n language assets. Existing canonical Composer/platform-input/Settings/Electron lifecycle/localization owners remain authoritative; no Nimf runtime or second candidate/preedit UI is justified.
